title: Integrality of the parametric push-forward: the image of countably many integer-weighted Lipschitz parameter domains under a Lipschitz map is an IM current, with per-domain bounds (Simon 6.3.6–3.9; step 7 of the selected proof)
statement: Assume (IMS), the exact frozen statement of dor_lmb_fc_im_series, and (IMC), the exact frozen statement of cmc_imRep_locality_restrict_sub. Let N, N', k ∈ ℕ, put d := k + 1, and let G_i : ℝᵈ → ℝ^N (i ∈ ℕ) be Lipschitz, B_i ⊆ ℝᵈ Borel with G_i differentiable at every point of B_i, and w_i : ℝᵈ → ℝ Borel, integer-valued at every point, nonzero at every point of B_i and Lebesgue-integrable on B_i, with Σ_i ∫⁻_{B_i} |w_i|·J_{G_i} dLᵈ < ∞ (J as in the sibling lipschitz_jacobian_locality). Let F : ℝ^N → ℝ^{N'} be Λ-Lipschitz. Then there is an integer multiplicity Y ∈ 𝒟_d(ℝ^{N'}) such that for every ω ∈ 𝒟^d(ℝ^{N'}) the series Σ_i T_i(ω), T_i(ω) := ∫_{B_i} w_i(u)·ω((F∘G_i)(u))(D(F∘G_i)(u)e_0, …, D(F∘G_i)(u)e_k) du, converges (HasSum) to Y(ω); and for every ω and every c > 0 with covectorEuclideanNorm(ω(x)) ≤ c for all x, |T_i(ω)| ≤ c·Λᵈ·(∫⁻_{B_i} |w_i|·J_{G_i} dLᵈ).toReal for every i.
